name: kb_delete
description: Delete entities by ID, or exact relationship triples. Use only for intentional removals after dependency checks. Do not use as a bulk cleanup shortcut. An entity authored in a Markdown or YAML source is not deleted directly: the call writes nothing and returns outcome plan_returned with a hash-bound deletionPlan and a nextActions entry holding the exact kb_apply_plan input ({plan, approvedPlanHash}); apply that unmodified, or repeat this call with approvedPlanHash = deletionPlan.planHash to apply the freshly computed plan in one step (a stale or different hash fails with DELETE_PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH and writes nothing). Authored requirements are never deleted: outcome supersession_required points to kb_upsert with a supersedes relationship. dryRun:true previews any delete and writes nothing. Side effects: mutates and saves KB and authored sources; skips entities with dependents; dryRun and plan_returned write nothing.

ids.description: Entity IDs to delete after dependency checks.

relationships.description: Exact relationship triples to retract, including legacy shard records.

approvedPlanHash.description: With ids only: the deletionPlan.planHash a prior call for the same ids returned. The plan is recomputed and applied through kb_apply_plan when its hash still matches; a mismatch fails with DELETE_PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH and writes nothing. Not allowed with relationships or dryRun.

dryRun.description: Preview without writing. Relationship and direct entity deletes run their preflight and return outcome dry_run with wouldDelete counts, the sourceWrites (paths and hashes) a commit would make, and skippedEffects. Authored ids return the same deletion plan as without dryRun.
